create_Model_subclass: create a subclass of Model that implements the abstract batch_type and generate_token methods
implement_generate_token: implement the generate_token method to return a tuple of generations and the next batch
use_decode_token: use decode_token to extract new text from a list of input token IDs with prefix offsets
check_model_initialized: check that all model parameters are initialized and not on the meta device
get_model_info: get the InfoResponse property from a Model instance to retrieve dtype, device, and chunking settings
